latent trajectories and recurrent reasoning stability

current_target_repo_observation.latest_observed_result: V17 candidate schema binding gap confirmed on accepted target VPS; V17 rejected as unguarded pending fail-closed binding repair and retest

primary_fusion.claim: LLM/agent inner state must be represented as multiple typed evidence layers rather than one mental-state/personality vector.
layers: verified outcome + causal credit + provenance-bound re-entry as validation

supported_discoveries: Human psychometrics are useful as experimental methods but cannot be assumed construct-valid for LLMs.
Big-Five output scores are not a defensible canonical LLM personality representation.
Persona/character behavior can have causal latent activation geometry while remaining distinct from identity and slow personality.
Functional emotion/appraisal representations can causally influence behavior without establishing subjective feeling.
Self-report and Chain-of-Thought are incomplete/unreliable internal-state channels and require external calibration.
Observability/decodability and actionability/causal control are distinct metrics.
Latent vectors/features can be non-identifiable; natural-language labels can collide across different features.
Quantization/compilation can preserve behavioral metrics while altering interpretable features, requiring post-binary revalidation.
A model-native J-space-like workspace and Frank's explicit Clay GWT are distinct candidate mechanisms requiring factorial testing rather than semantic collapse.
Latent trajectory signals are plausible incremental features for adaptive recurrence, but only if they beat the current LoopDynamicsReadout baseline under held-out/OOD matched costs.
hypotheses: H-DUAL-GWT-02 native model workspace and Clay GWT are complementary but distinct
H-OA-05 observability and actionability are separate axes
H-HYPER-LATENT-06 preserve representational equivalence sets in Hyperposition
H-APPRAISAL-07 functional affect is fast appraisal not slow personality
H-BINARY-08 latent probes require post-binary recalibration
H-LATENT-LOOP-09 latent dynamics may incrementally improve recurrence control
H-SLOW-10 slow personality plasticity remains effect-coupled
H-IDENTITY-11 identity lies outside machine psychometrics
strongest_counterhypotheses: System receipts + behavioral outcomes + current external loop readouts are sufficient; LCOP adds cost and fragility without useful gain.
J-space-like workspace findings are model/method-specific and redundant with Clay GWT.
Prompt-level persona control performs as well as factorized personality with less state complexity.
Latent probes suffer confounds/non-identifiability and should not enter runtime control.
Verified-outcome-only slow plasticity may be too sparse and rigid; staged self-reflection proposals may be needed.
Human psychological constructs may be actively misleading even when they correlate with model behavior.

highest_value_next_experiment.name: dual workspace factorial
highest_value_next_experiment.design: NativeModelWorkspace intact/lesioned/steered x ClayGWT truthful/shuffled/no-reentry, split complex reasoning vs automatic tasks, with matched frozen inputs/seeds and model-output-frozen controls where technically meaningful.

negative_results_and_limits: No evidence reviewed supports phenomenal consciousness or subjective feeling claims.
No specific latent mechanism is promoted into Frank because the final model/build measurement surface has not been validated here.
No claim is made that Anthropic J-space generalizes unchanged to Frank's eventual final model.
No human personality inventory is accepted as canonical Frank personality semantics.
No target Frank repository mutation was performed in this research run.
The latest target V17 effect-reentry candidate currently has a confirmed schema-binding gap; this is preserved as a separate blocker rather than rationalized away.
